24.original: Survey Namai from a safe distance.

48.original: It seems peaceful enough to me...

49.original: Even if there aren't any soldiers in the village, it would be foolish to simply stride in and announce ourselves.

50.original: Let no man claim that I am reckless. Prudence has ever been my watchword! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─venture closer, if you would, and confirm that there are no soldiers lurking about.

51.original: Forgive me, my friend, but unlike Yugiri, I am not made for the shadows.

52.original: Who is this boy, and where is he taking us?

53.original: Judging from the reactions of the villagers, it's probably for the best that we left.

54.original: I do not understand it! Was it not clear that we wished to remain awhile?

55.original: I don't know who you people think you are, but do you have any idea what would happen to us if you were found in our village!?

56.original: Again you address us with unwarranted spite! I have let your impropriety pass until now, but no longer!

57.original: Who are you, boy, to speak to me thus? Know you not who I am?

58.original: (-Isse-)<hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> am Isse of Namai─a farmer, like my father before me, and his father before him. I wouldn't expect a man like you to know who I am─but I know you. We all do!

59.original: (-Isse-)Lord Kaien's retainer and leader of the rebellion─Gosetsu! Notorious fugitive, wanted dead or alive by the Empire!

60.original: Hah hah hah hah hah! Is that what this is all about?

61.original: I am hardly the first man to earn the ire of the Empire. Nor will I be the last.

62.original: Was not Namai home to brave and true warriors, who fought beneath our banners for king and country?

63.original: (-Isse-)They fought, and they died. Every last one. And then the imperials came looking for more. Because of them.

64.original: (-Isse-)They were <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> close to killing us all─to burning our village to the ground. We've only just begun to enjoy some semblance of peace...

65.original: (-Isse-)Never again─never again, do you understand!? We've had enough of you and yours! Whatever it is you're plotting, leave us out of it!

66.original: ...Hmm. Impassioned as his pleas may be, surely he must know that I cannot leave things as they are.

67.original: But for now, I shall respect his wishes. We must continue on towards our final destination─the House of the Fierce. Proud headquarters of the Doman Liberation Front.

68.original: There is a secret entrance to the north of Namai, by way of a small spring. Come─I will show you!

70.original: And there I was thinking our swimming days were behind us.

71.original: This way, this way! We must dive into the water!

72.original: Have no fear, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! It is but a short distance. You need not hold your breath for long!

73.original: Kami be praised! I know you!

75.original: Congratulations, my friends! You are come to the House of the Fierce!
